scope: Diagnostic syscall tracing on original execution actors, accepted-entry lifetime and console probe dependency
limits: This removes every logging-only coordinator exclusion and Snapshot::owner_syscalls; actual excluded resource/capability and host administration boundaries remain. It does not add guest ptrace support.

Diagnostic state and line scratch are optional and task-owned. Queue wake/timeout producers record only; actual existing executors format/write outside scheduling locks, without another logger/resource thread.

Actual stderr I/O remains a cost and may block its calling host thread. A shared diagnostic stream is a real shared resource; this is not zero-cost tracing or cancellable I/O. Diagnostic write errors do not become guest errno.
These are syscall/diagnostic fixtures, not Firefox/Geekbench performance or native equivalence claims. Native reference timings have no diagnostic output.

Initial cached/pure Darwin getpid allowed the compiler to eliminate/hoist query work, so its near-zero times are discarded as kernel-crossing references. The corrected control uses SDK SYS_getpid=20 via syscall(); generated assembly retains _syscall inside the loop. Darwin varargs wrapper/ABI differs from the raw Linux AArch64 SVC.

The earlier Darwin-only fixture correction kept its Linux ELF byte-identical. The final v2 fixture subsequently adds explicit metadata-completion probes outside the timed query loop; final paired runs use the same v2 ELF on both runners.
Native ARM64 Linux references run in the existing six-vCPU CI instance. It is stopped for paired HVF timings. Background host workload and native scheduler behavior still differ.
Final short untraced controls range from -0.03% to +0.55%. The earlier buffered prototype long control is -1.1%; no universal zero-overhead or final long-control claim is made.

One original file-layout external-View assertion failed once under concurrent build load; the unchanged assertion passed 30 isolated repeats and final full process runs on both hosts. Its initial cause is not claimed fixed.

The initial fixture omitted /tmp setup for the interpreter empty filesystem; explicit mkdir fixes the fixture. The small traced policy test budget was rejected by the original source-work assertion; the full original 100000-instruction budget is retained for both traced and untraced matrices.
